Режим «Редактирование» меняет вашу автор: «Editing» changes your authored version immediately. Other participants see the result in the collaborative version, but their changes are not written to your physical Git file.
Отмена убирает вашу последнюю редакторск: Undo removes your last editing operation; redo restores it. A new edit may discard the redo branch – this is normal editor history behaviour.
Не редактируйте YAML-заголовок и ключ сл: Avoid changing the YAML header or the key to the left of the value unnecessarily. Before committing, open «Local file» and check your personal result: this is what is materialised in the repository and appears in GitHub Desktop.
Режим «Правки» не заменяет исходный текс: «Suggestions» does not immediately replace the original text. Typing, deleting and replacing creates a suggestion with removed and added parts, like Google Docs. You can change a letter, a whole word or several lines.
Пока вы продолжаете печатать внутри свое: As you keep typing within your open suggestion, Hub updates the same card. Card buttons let you reply, continue editing, accept, reject or delete it. Acceptance inserts the text into the document; rejection records the decision without applying it, subject to your account permissions.
Отмена в этом режиме убирает последнюю с: Undo in this mode removes your last created or edited suggestion; redo restores it. Line breaks are allowed at word boundaries, not in the middle of a protected word.
Для комментария выделите текст и нажмите: To comment, select text and click «Comment» or use the editor’s context menu. Replies immediately notify the discussion author. Closed discussions remain in history and can be shown using the accepted/closed filter.
Бронь создаётся по выделению слева. Выбе: Create a reservation from a selection on the left. Choose an assignee and optionally add a note. Reservations communicate team intentions but do not technically block editing or replace agreements between people.
Не создавайте несколько карточек про оди: Avoid creating multiple cards for the same passage unnecessarily. Reply in the existing card: its author receives a notification and the context stays together.
Сервер хранит общий документ и независим: The server stores the shared document and independent authored changes. By default, the working file is built as «Git HEAD + only my changes», so other people’s edits do not enter your commit without selection.
У каждого ключа, которым совместная верс: Every key that differs between the collaborative version and Git HEAD has a checkbox to the left of its line number. Clicking includes only that change in the local file; clicking again restores its Git version. Added and deleted keys are selected independently too.
Кнопка «Локальный файл» показывает полны: «Local file» shows the complete difference list and the same checkboxes with before/after versions. A green banner remains above the editor while any collaborative change is included in the local file. «Clear all and write Git HEAD» clears the selection; «Restore Git + mine» restores your authored version.
Hub tracks supported `.yml` files in `localisation/russian`, `localisation/english`, `localisation/replace/russian` and `localisation/replace/english`. A commit outside these folders should not block work.
Жёлтая плашка сообщает о новом коммите в: A yellow banner indicates a new branch commit. A red banner appears only if the missed commits changed the open file. Editing resumes after pulling in GitHub Desktop and Agent reconnecting automatically; you can also use the safe repository update button.
При смене ветки дождитесь завершения пер: When switching branches, wait for GitHub Desktop to finish. Agent checks that Git is stable and reconnects Review. If Git reports a detached or unknown branch, the interface temporarily becomes read-only instead of inventing a branch name.
Конфликт возникает, когда одна и та же л: A conflict occurs when the same localisation entity diverges between the Git base, collaborative version and external file. Open the conflict on the left: the diff shows both sides with long lines wrapped.
«Оставить совместный» выбирает вариант H: «Keep collaborative» chooses Hub’s version; «Use Git» chooses the working Git side. Read the diff before applying a decision. After successful resolution, the card should disappear without restarting Agent or Review.
Если конфликт уже разрешён, но карточка: If a resolved conflict card remains, do not keep clicking the decision. Wait for the state to be recalculated. If an error persists, save its message and the file path for diagnosis.
Тикет фиксирует базовую ветку, базовый к: A ticket records its base branch, base commit and file list. Work inside it is isolated from the main version. Use «All tickets» to search, change status, open and archive tickets according to your account permissions.
Если базовая ветка ушла вперёд, rebase п: If the base branch advances, rebase moves the ticket onto the new Git commit and reports conflicts separately. Applying a ticket checks the expected revisions of all files before atomically transferring the result to the main documents. A translation role is required to apply tickets.
Автор тикета получает десятиминутные сво: Ticket authors receive ten-minute summaries of status actions and separate editing summaries: who worked and how many lines, words and characters were affected. These figures are guidance, not a substitute for reviewing the diff.
«Английский оригинал» берёт ключ под кур: «English original» reads the key under the cursor and opens its paired English file read-only. Files in `localisation/replace/russian` are paired with files in `localisation/replace/english`.
«Изменить по ключам» принимает строки ви: «Replace by keys» accepts lines such as `key:0 "text"` or `key: "text"`. Choose Russian or English and inspect the preview first. The search covers the normal and `replace` folders for that language. Missing or ambiguous keys block application; contributors without translation roles can change English files only.
«Сверка» сравнивает парные русский и анг: «Audit» compares paired Russian and English files in two modes. «Keys» shows missing and duplicate keys. «Lines and order» compares physical line counts, blank lines, key order and standalone comment lines. The optional version marker `:0` is equivalent to `:`. Tails after a key value, such as #Snow #First event, are visible but their differences are not treated as errors.
«История» показывает совместные серверны: «History» shows shared server versions: who changed the text and when. Restoration creates a new version without deleting older history, comments, reservations or suggestions, subject to editing permissions.
«Git diff» показывает историю коммитов и: «Git diff» shows this file’s commit history and follows renames. Choose left and right commits independently to compare any earlier version with HEAD.
Версии истории, Git diff, diff тикетов и: History versions, Git diffs, ticket diffs and localisation audits are cached on this computer for faster reopening. The cache has a size limit and is not a replacement for the originals. Clear it in «Settings → Local diff cache».
Ответ на ваш комментарий или обсуждение: Replies to your comments or suggestion discussions arrive immediately. Acceptance and rejection of your suggestions are grouped into one ten-minute summary. Ticket state actions and ticket editing have separate ten-minute summaries.
Колокольчик «Уведомления» показывает неп: «Notifications» shows the unread count. The list and settings are local to this computer. The server keeps a limited delivery journal so Review can retrieve missed events after a brief disconnection.
В «Настройки» можно независимо выключить: In «Settings», independently disable all notifications or just sound. Both are enabled by default. Disabling them does not affect collaboration or change anyone else’s settings.
Desktop Agent должен быть запущен и авто: Desktop Agent must be running and authenticated: it connects local Git, Review and the server. Closing its window stops Agent by default. Enable notification-area mode if you deliberately want it to run in the background.

Прохождение каждого раздела записывается: Completion of each tutorial section is saved to your server account, so reinstalling does not reset it. «Settings → Repeat tutorial» starts an optional review. Future features may add a mandatory section or increase an existing section’s revision.
